name: OPAIJA_GROWTH_ENGINE_MEMORY
purpose: Shared memory for building a fast Opaija tribe across organic content, paid ads, email, story blog, founder drops, merch, books, and digital collectibles.
north_star: Build owned audience through email while social and paid channels create reach.
handoff_rules: Story Agent creates lore and character hooks for Growth Agent.
FX Agent creates high-retention action clips for TikTok/Shorts/Reels.
Growth Agent returns winning fan language to Story, Merch, and Books.
Email Agent tags leads by source, character interest, merch interest, book interest, and founder interest.
Merch Agent uses winning phrases and characters to decide product drops.
Book Engine uses high-interest story beats to prioritize KDP samples.
Paid Ads Agent only scales hooks that prove organic or lead-capture signal first.
compliance: Do not promise NFT financial value.
Do not auto-publish paid ads without approval.
Keep source and UTM tracking on all leads.
Respect platform ad policies for entertainment, youth-safe content, and data use.
